scope: All ETCSRI corpusjson Q files in the already saved archive; editorial target cf utud or tud AND gloss/sense birth/bear. Names and substring itud excluded.
selection: Extract every target token, including damage, and preserve before/after context. First target by lexical Q id will be first photo candidate; composite Q is not a physical object.
controls: Inventory all verb citation forms ending in d; inspect fixed semantic areas find, long/stretch, distant, lie as available. No rule d→zero inferred from a single pair.
prior_exposure: Prior archive and grammatical descriptions known; this is corpus audit, not blind decipherment.
stages: inspect any available photographs separately from Latin edition
compare target morphological environments and independent controls
limits: No proof of genealogy from a corpus lemma
No case ending reclassified as part of root merely to improve similarity
Do not confuse modern Kazakh -ды tense marker with reconstructed Sumerian final d
